subject: Follow-up: Integration discovery + 5xx repro (embeddings -> reranker)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@finlytics.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-18T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: Integration architecture + next steps

Hi Sam — thanks again for the discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can unblock the POC: 

Summary of your architecture we discussed:
- Frontend sends user query -> backend service (Java) -> calls Redwood API for embeddings + reranker.
- You plan to use embeddings for retrieval from your vector DB, then reranker to re-score top-K candidates.
- Auth: currently using a service API key embedded in your backend (long-lived).
- Throughput target: 50 req/s for retrieval + re-rank during peak.

See notes / asks:
1) SDK setup: we'll share recommended Node/Python snippets for batched embeddings and streaming reranking.
2) Auth: recommend rotating short-lived keys or using our connector with your KMS for Private deployments.
3) Routing: for costs, route lower-SLA traffic to a cheaper model; we can set routing policy in config.
4) Structured output / tool-calling: if you plan to call internal tools, we advise using function-calling and deterministic output formats to simplify reranker input.

You mentioned intermittent 5xx responses during early testing — please send the failing request payload, the exact timestamp, and any logs. That will let us reproduce and advise timeout/retry settings.

Next steps (proposed):
- Sam: send sample failing payload + logs (ETA by EOD 6/18)
- Marissa & Camila: follow up with SDK examples + recommended timeouts/retry/backoff
- Rishi: we'll loop you in if we need an internal repro and server-side logs

Thanks — looking forward to getting the POC stable.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
--
Attachment: integration-checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finlytics Platform Team <platform@finlytics.io>
Date: 2026-06-18T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Integration architecture + next steps

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. I've attached a small repro set and logs (repro-logs.txt + sample-payload.json). Quick context:

- We see 5xxs intermittently when we call the reranker endpoint after doing embeddings + retrieval. The flow:
  1) POST /v1/embeddings -> returns vectors
  2) find top-100 in our vector DB
  3) POST /v1/rerank with ~100 candidates + original query

- When the candidate set is ~100 and each candidate has ~1-2KB of metadata, the rerank call sometimes returns 500 internal server error.
- Earliest failing timestamp in our logs: 2026-06-18T15:58:12Z (attached).
- We didn't add client-side retries yet; requests are single-shot with 10s timeout in our HTTP client.

Attaching: repro-logs.txt, sample-payload.json

Can you please advise quick mitigations?

Thanks,
Sam
Senior Engineering Manager, Finlytics
sam.taylor@finlytics.com

--
Attachment: repro-logs.txt (stub), sample-payload.json (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@finlytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-18T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Integration architecture + next steps

Thanks Sam — got the attachments and logs. Looping in Rishi (support) and Camila (engineer) to help reproduce and provide mitigation steps. Initial observations:

- The sample payload looks valid JSON but the rerank body size looks large (~200KB). That's within typical limits but may trigger internal circuit breakers when coupled with CPU spikes.
- Your client timeout of 10s could be tripping on cold starts; we usually recommend 30s+ for rerank requests with ~100 candidates, or streaming the model output if the SDK supports it.

Rishi / Camila, can you check whether the 500s correlate with internal rate-limiting or memory pressure? Sam: if you can also share the exact curl request (headers + body) used at 2026-06-18T15:58:12Z that will help.

Tentative quick mitigations for Sam to try:
- Increase client timeout from 10s -> 30s.
- Add exponential backoff + 3 retries for 5xx.
- Reduce rerank candidate set to top-25 as a test.
- Switch to batched embeddings to reduce upstream latency and ensure you use our binary-optimized payloads (if using SDK).

I'll follow up with an internal repro plan and recommended SDK config.

Best,
Marissa

From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-19T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Integration discovery + 5xx repro (embeddings -> reranker)

Thanks Rishi — that guidance is helpful. I implemented the following this morning:
- Increased timeout to 30s
- Added 3 retries with exponential backoff for 5xx
- Reduced candidate set from 100 -> 25 for rerank test

I ran a 2-hour load test starting 2026-06-19T09:30:00Z and saw zero 5xxs in that window. I'll roll these changes into our staging environment and report back after a larger run tomorrow.

One follow-up question: is there a recommended max body size per rerank call you enforce? We want to tune client-side batching to stay within safe limits.

Thanks again,
Sam

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@finlytics.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-20T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Integration discovery + 5xx repro (embeddings -> reranker)

Great to hear the 2-hour test looked clean, Sam. Answering your question:

- We don't publish a hard body-size limit in the hosted API SLA, but we recommend keeping individual request bodies under ~512KB for reranker calls to avoid gateway pressure. If you need larger payloads at scale, consider:
  - Chunking candidates and making multiple rerank calls in parallel (e.g., 4x calls with top-25 each).
  - Using compressed payloads (Content-Encoding: gzip).
  - For very high throughput, consider Dedicated capacity where the gateway behavior is tuned to your deployment.

I'll also follow up with an internal note on temporarily increasing the gateway worker pool for your account during the POC window (6/19 - 6/26). If you can share staging load test links or CloudWatch metrics, we'll correlate.

Thanks — we'll keep monitoring and I can re-open a ticket if anything recurs.

Best,
Camila
Software Engineer, Runtime | Redwood Inference
